Configures what the unauthenticated /api/version endpoint discloses about the running build.

| Key | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`version.mode`](#mode) | string | `show` |

## `mode`

`string`, default `show`

Selects what the endpoint reveals:

```yaml
"show"          the real version, commit, and release URL (default)
"hide"          nothing; every field is empty
any other value that string, reported as the version, with no
                commit, repository, or release link that would give
                the real build away
```

The two words "show" and "hide" are therefore reserved and cannot themselves be used as a fake version string.

```yaml
version:
  mode: "show"
```
